patterns.note: Content is presented in a centered, fixed-width column with generous vertical spacing between distinct sections, creating clear visual breaks and a sense of spaciousness.
A heavy, condensed sans-serif typeface is used for all headings and prominent text, establishing a bold and authoritative tone throughout the page.
A high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates, with a subtle light grey used only for alternating section backgrounds, drawing focus to the content and calls to action.
No scroll-triggered motion or animations are present; the page relies on static visual hierarchy and clear section breaks to guide the user.
Major content sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (white, light grey, and solid black), providing strong visual segmentation and rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: To achieve the stark, high-contrast aesthetic, use a limited palette of pure black, pure white, and a single very light grey for background variations, ensuring text readability.

Implement a strong typographic hierarchy by pairing an extremely bold, condensed display font for all headings and emphasized text with a standard, legible sans-serif for body copy, creating visual weight and clarity.
Structure the page with fixed-width content containers centered on the screen, separated by substantial vertical spacing to create distinct, easily digestible content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, extra-bold, condensed headings (~3-4x body) with standard-sized, legible body text and smaller uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between main sections and within content blocks, creating an open and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its stark, high-contrast black and white aesthetic combined with an extremely bold, condensed typeface that gives it an almost academic textbook feel. The use of simple, graphic illustrations of layout patterns further reinforces its educational and direct approach, making it feel less like a typical marketing site and more like a definitive guide.
